name: update_basket
description: Replace the restaurant basket shown in the Wolt app with one requested change. This never places an order and never charges a card. Item IDs come from get_menu; option configuration and value IDs come from get_item_options.

slug.description: Restaurant slug, as returned by search_restaurants.

action.description: One of: add, set_count, set_options, or remove.

item_id.description: Menu item ID from get_menu. Required for every action.

count.description: Positive item count. Required for add and set_count.

option_selections.description: Selected options. Required for set_options and optional for add. set_options replaces the item's complete option selection: an empty list clears every option, and omitted configurations are cleared. Each entry has configuration_id and values; each value has id and positive count. Configuration and value IDs come from get_item_options.
